{{Quote|Lord Vader, we are detecting the signatures of several large vessels entering the Kamino system. They lack Imperial transponders and will not reply to our hails.|Signals officer to Darth Vader|<ref name="TFUIINovel" />}}
A [[Gender/Legends|male]] '''signals officer''' was a member of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]].<ref name="TFUIINovel" /> In [[1 BBY/Legends|1 BBY]],<ref name="TFUIIComic">[[Star Wars: The Force Unleashed II (graphic novel)|''Star Wars: The Force Unleashed II'' graphic novel]]</ref> the signals [[Officer/Legends|officer]] informed the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] that several large [[Starship/Legends|vessels]] had entered the [[Kamino system/Legends|Kamino system]]. Vader told him to inform [[Fleet Commander/Legends|Fleet Commander]] [[Touler]] that it was time to begin the [[Assault on Kamino|battle]].<ref name="TFUIINovel" />
